result:
I did not finish this task. Only the run over card (screens 52, 55) and the operator menu (62, 63) were changed, and no listed screen has reached 4 from the critic.

Three of my drafts shipped:
- **`cw-party-op` (62, 63):** this put the operator menu on the shared look. I did not re-run the critic on it.
- **`cw-party-over` (v29.47):** this moved the run over card (52, 55) onto the shared panel. The initials cards (53, 54) use the same panel, so they changed too.
- **`cw-party-over2` (v29.49):** this made the card wider and hides the PILLAGERS wordmark while the card is up.

The critic still scores screen 55 a 2 of 5, though it says the new version is better than the old one. It wants four things:
- A dimmed world behind the card. The test shot shows the card on pure black, because the attract screen has no video there.
- A centred 720 px card with centred content.
- The stats shown as four cells, a value over a label.
- A Continue button instead of the floating "Press any button" line.

A follow-up draft, `cw-party-over3`, would centre the card at 720 px. It failed preflight and I did not ship it. It conflicts with three older checks:
- **29.47:** wants the card left-aligned.
- **29.49:** is my own check and wants it 840 px wide.
- **29.33:** rejects raw px values. The fix is to use menu-w times 1.29 instead of 720px.

Retargeting those checks means editing `tools/mkfixture.ps1` under the lock, then shipping `cw-party-over3`.

I did not start screens 46, 47, 48, 49, 54, 56, 58, 63 and 64. Before pictures for them are in `notes/shots/12-before2/`.

I logged the run over card change in `notes/ui/changes.md`. I did not add anything to the Changes section of `notes/ui/index.html`. My notes are in `notes/12-ui-party-screens.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: the run over card (52, 55) is stuck at 2 of 5 until the three fixture checks are retargeted and `cw-party-over3` ships; screens 46, 47, 48, 49, 53, 54, 56, 58, 63 and 64 are untouched or unscored; 62 has not been re-scored.
